verdict.rationale: Beamer's own changelog docs say users can create segments based on user attributes such as role, features used, profile and demographics, and send more relevant, targeted messages for product updates. That is the story's core capability. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation on how segments are defined and applied to individual release posts, clarity on plan gating (pricing lists segmentation as an 'advanced feature'), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can segment product release announcements by user attributes to send targeted release notes
